QUESTIONS ABOUT LEARNING

Good to know before you enrol

How do I find a course for my industry?

Start by choosing an industry, then browse its available project management courses and review the curriculum.

When can I access a purchased course?

Access to the selected course is provided after your payment is successfully confirmed.

What learning materials are included?

Depending on the course, modules may include videos, documents, images, notes, templates and quizzes.

Can I see how far I have progressed?

Yes. Your learner dashboard and course modules show basic progress and module status.
